title: Complete yellow only with retained build cash
description: Complete yellow only with retained build cash. Yellow can work if Alpha keeps enough cash to build afterward. The offer has to be credible to the counterparty while preserving Alpha's actual strategic edge.

final_action.public_message: Hey Beta, I'd like to trade you Marvin Gardens for $200 and the Electric Company. Let me know if you're interested!
final_action.private_thought: Acquiring Marvin Gardens completes my Yellow monopoly (Atlantic, Ventnor, Marvin). This will let me build houses soon, increasing rent dramatically. Offering $200 + utility seems fair; I retain enough cash for houses later.
